notes.title: Dev. Update #8 - Ver. 1.0.8 - 23
notes.content:
[b]Hello Community,[/b]

Today, a significant update has been released in response to repeated criticisms regarding ammunition scarcity, team revivals, and high point exchange costs.

It's worth highlighting the introduction of new languages in the game.

I hope this update can contribute to improving the player experience.

[b]Ammunition[/b]
[hr][/hr]
Comprehensive adjustments have been made to all weapons to improve ammunition availability.

From now on, an increased amount of ammunition is available for every available weapon.
[list]
[*]ACWI: Ammunition increased from 75 to 275.
[*]ACWI Var Assault: Ammunition increased from 75 to 275.
[*]AK-110: Ammunition increased from 75 to 275, and magazine capacity increased from 40 to 60.
[*]M890 Shotgun: Ammunition increased from 48 to 144, and magazine capacity increased from 8 to 16.
[*]46 Shotgun: Ammunition increased from 80 to 160, and magazine capacity increased from 8 to 16.
[*]CM-2000 Sniper: Magazine capacity increased from 15 to 60.
[*]SCB-750 Sniper: Ammunition increased from 15 to 60, and magazine capacity increased from 3 to 9.
[*]N90 LMG: Ammunition increased from 120 to 360.
[*]V014 SMG: Ammunition increased from 120 to 240, and magazine capacity increased from 32 to 64.
[*]GTM SMG: Ammunition increased from 120 to 240, and magazine capacity increased from 32 to 64.
[*]Judge-45 Pistol: Magazine capacity increased from 36 to 72.
[*]PR-9 Pistol: Magazine capacity increased from 36 to 72.
[*]PP9 SMG: Ammunition increased from 128 to 200.
[/list]

[b]Melee[/b]
[hr][/hr]
Special attention has been given to shorten and improve the animation time for striking with a firearm, making firearm strikes considerably faster. These changes also extend to melee weapons such as baseball bats or an axe, where not only were the animations optimized but also the damage caused was increased. It's important to emphasize that melee weapons like the baseball bat now inflict more damage than striking with a firearm.
[list]
[*]Striking with a firearm now causes damage ranging from a minimum of 150 to a maximum of 400.
[/list]
[list]
[*]For handguns and axes, the damage has been increased from a minimum of 240 / maximum of 340 to a minimum of 440 / maximum of 800.
[/list]
[list]
[*]For handguns and baseball bats, the damage has been increased from a minimum of 240 / maximum of 340 to a minimum of 400 / maximum of 700.
[/list]

[b]Character Revivals[/b]
[hr][/hr]
Additionally, the revival time for your teammates has been reduced to expedite the process. Note that the character Doc still revives faster than a regular character.

All characters now have a default revival time of 7 seconds, compared to the previous 12 seconds.

However, the character "Doc" now has a reduced revival time of 3 seconds, compared to the previous 5 seconds.

[b]Traps[/b]
[hr][/hr]
Traps have also been revamped. They are now easier to activate, cause more damage than before, and have improved activation times. The point costs have also been reduced.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41611697/aad82345c0d70ff397d689bd0588bb3a3d7cf7f7.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41611697/00f1bcc261c17fd003535b5a4e9a2dccaa3638bf.jpg[/img]

[b]Container Breaches[/b]
[hr][/hr]
The cost of opening containers was previously high, but it has now been reduced from 4,000 points to 1,500 points.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41611697/bd2a91243ab568a2a93ab2996cf253a518bd16cb.jpg[/img]

[b]Random Weapon Crates[/b]
[hr][/hr]
The costs for random weapon crates have been lowered, especially for heavy weapons.
[list]
[*]The point costs for normal weapon crates have been reduced from 1,000 to 200.
[/list]
[list]
[*]The point costs for heavy weapon crates have been reduced from 4,000 to 2,000.
[/list]

Character Healing
[hr][/hr]
The point costs for character healing have been reduced and adjusted.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41611697/521b6cde45591690074eb2a331bea917ae94529d.jpg[/img]

notes.title: PURGE - Three vs Blood
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41611697/8b2ba2b85f8d53e3910c93e6c7c0f692a8a3ce86.png[/img]

[b]Hello Community[/b], as announced the change of the game name is now completed.

From now on the game is officially called: [b]PURGE - Three vs Blood[/b]

With the new name I would also like to give the game a new start. I have often tried to make the game more popular, unfortunately I have not succeeded. 

You will receive further announcements in the upcoming update news.

If you have problems that your SaveGame is not loaded. Here you can find out how to get your SaveGame back. https://steamcommunity.com/app/1843710/discussions/0/3597842130155291662/

The offered game is an indie game. What exactly is an indie game, you can learn here: https://steamcommunity.com/app/1843710/discussions/0/3597842130158245133/

[b]PURGE - Three vs Blood[/b] is an arena zombie apocalypse where you fight with up to 3 players against ravenous zombie waves and unlock ranks, maps and unique characters. A variety of light to heavy weapons and traps are at your disposal!

[b]Are you ready?[/b] Your concentration will be challenged to the point of exhaustion. How many waves can you manage? Compete alone or with friends in co-op mode with up to 3 players against the enemy zombie herd. Your task is to hold off the ravenous zombies for as long as possible. With each wave that starts, the zombie wave gets stronger. You earn points and can exchange them for new weapons, traps and other areas at any time. 

[b]Be ready to help your teammates at any time.[/b] When a player is injured, you'll hear it through a pulsating heart. You only have a few seconds to save him, otherwise he'll be lost forever until you finish your wave.

[b]New Languages:[/b] The game is now also provided with more languages, I want to give users the possibility to use their languages as well. Currently the languages Dutch and Italian have been added. I ask for your understanding, if the translations are not perfect or could come to misunderstandings, if you find problems, I would be grateful if you could inform me about it.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1995850

notes.title: KeepUp Hunter - Release - RoadMap - News
notes.content:
[h1]Hello Community,[/h1]

Today is the day of the release and I hope you will like it. But I ASK you to use the Early Access process only if you are interested in influencing and supporting the development. If necessary, they prefer to wait until full release (probably in about 3 to 6 months).

I've been thinking for a long time about how to make a wave-based game interesting. Personally, I didn't find it easy to come up with a good solution either. I decided to use a rank system, with this rank system more maps and characters are unlocked. The different maps should provide variety, ideas or wishes for future maps are welcome. Not all maps have zones, zones are more areas that you unlock through points, these zones have better weapons and give you more room to play. All characters have different abilities, from faster running, healing or better weapons should bring you advantages in the game, ideas are also welcome.

notes.title: KeepUp Hunter - News
notes.content:
[h1]Hello Community,[/h1]

I would like to inform you that the release is planned for April 2022. However, I had to consider some things differently than planned.

KeepUp Hunter will be in EA process for some time (probably around 3 months) to work out balancing with community and find issues if any. Only use Early Access if you are interested in influencing and supporting the development.

If necessary, they prefer to wait until full release. The EA process is not for every user. Take the opportunity to ask your questions before you buy it. 

Once this process is complete, the game will be enhanced with quarterly, saison-ppdates that will be available to users for free. These will include new playable maps, playable characters, and extras. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41611697/31c55e8323e02ac65d02b50b14e9466f297bca02.jpg[/img]

[b]With KeepUp Hunter[/b], I want to bring you a wave-based zombie game. You'll fight non-stop against a herd of zombies that won't end.

You have several characters to choose from, all characters have standard weapons at the beginning. Your task is to hold off the ravenous zombies for as long as possible. With each wave that starts, the zombie wave gets stronger. You earn points and can exchange them for new weapons, traps and other areas at any time.

[b]At release[/b] of KeepUp Hunter, there will be two to three selectable maps, with more planned. All maps will have a dynamic weather system, ranging from sunny mornings and evenings to heavy thunderstorms and thick fog.
